title: Real-Time Detection of Charge Jumps in Superconducting Qubits with a Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2607.14293v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ionizing radiation from cosmic rays and gammas can induce discontinuous jumps in the environmental charge of superconducting qubits (charge jumps), causing correlated errors that challenge fault-tolerant quantum computing while simultaneously providing a detection signature for quantum sensing applications. Current detection methods operate offline, introducing latency incompatible with in-the-loop qubit control. In this paper, an online detector of charge jumps for superconducting qubits, based on a dilated causal convolutional neural network (DCCNN) designed for in-the-loop deployment on the Quantum Instrumentation Control Kit (QICK) platform, is presented. translated_title: 基于卷积神经网络的超导量子比特电荷跳变实时检测
translated_abstract: 来自宇宙射线和伽马射线的电离辐射会在超导量子比特的环境电荷中引起不连续的跳变（电荷跳变），从而产生相关联的错误，这对容错量子计算构成挑战，同时也为量子传感应用提供了检测信号。目前的检测方法均为离线运行，其引入的延迟与在线（in-the-loop）量子比特控制不兼容。本文提出了一种用于超导量子比特的电荷跳变在线检测器，该检测器基于扩张因果卷积神经网络（DCCNN）设计，用于在量子仪器控制套件（QICK）平台上进行在线部署。该网络在由费米实验室西北实验地下站点（NEXUS）测量的量子比特模板生成的合成拉姆齐层析扫描数据上进行训练，并通过hls4ml以ap_fixed⟨16,6⟩量化转换为FPGA固件，达到……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩张因果卷积神经网络（DCCNN）的电荷跳变在线检测器，通过hls4ml量化部署到QICK平台的FPGA固件上，实现了超导量子比特电荷跳变的实时检测，解决了现有离线检测方法延迟过高、无法用于闭环量子比特控制的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an online charge-jump detector for superconducting qubits based on a dilated causal convolutional neural network, deployed as quantized FPGA firmware on the QICK platform to enable real-time, in-the-loop detection that overcomes the latency limitations of existing offline methods.
